About Hatua Maseno Chapter

Young people helping young people

The Maseno Chapter of Hatua Network is a community of passionate youth who learn, serve, and grow together. Through education, soft-skills development, and professional networks, we open doors so that every member can take the next step (hatua) toward a better future for themselves and their families.

Mission & Vision

What drives us

🎯

Our Mission

Hatua equips Kenyan youth with the education, soft skills, and professional networks they need to end the cycle of generational poverty in their families.

🔭

Our Vision

A future in which every young person has equal access to the resources and opportunities they need to achieve economic well-being.
